preconditions.description: The number of test cases q must be between 1 and 10000.
For each test case, the length of the string n and the substring length k must satisfy 1 <= k <= n <= 10^6.

preconditions.expression: len(s) == n and all(c in '01' for c in s)
preconditions.description: The string s must have length n and consist only of characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' if not any(t in s[i:i+k] for i in range(n-k+1)) else stdout == 'YES'
postconditions.description: If no beautiful string exists, output 'NO'; otherwise, output 'YES'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'YES' and len(t) == k and all(c in '01' for c in t)
postconditions.description: If a beautiful string exists, output 'YES' followed by the lexicographically smallest beautiful string t of length k.

postconditions.expression: all(any(t[j] == s[i+j] for i in range(n-k+1)) for j in range(k))
postconditions.description: The beautiful string t must be bit similar to all substrings of s of length k.
